prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup asset extraction. The reference is an approved game UI concept. Produce the EMPTY REUSABLE BACKGROUND for that EXACT warm parchment scroll UI, landscape 16:9. Reproduce the tangible cylindrical ivory scroll rods along left and right 3% edges with restrained engraved antique-bronze endcaps, faint binding seams, stacked worn parchment edges, richly painted fibrous ivory paper, subtle fold/contact shadow, charcoal-brown textile behind the outermost edges and only tiny muted autumn leaves at extreme outside corners. Completely remove all text, icons, buttons, illustrations, panels, columns, diagrams, objects and gold glows from the inner 88% usable page. The entire inner page is clean soft warm pale ivory parchment, no dark-blue area, no central seam, no diagonal perspective. Front-on perfectly rectangular UI with lightly uneven organic perimeter. Keep textures clean and light enough for readable black text. This should look materially as gorgeous as the approved reference rather than a generic rectangle of beige noise. NO WORDS, LETTERS, SYMBOLS or inset boxes. No brush across content. High resolution usable game background.

Use case: game illustration atlas. Match the approved reference's superb painted gold-and-ink mountain art, ivory paper and mellow mineral pigments. Output a precisely aligned atlas of THREE EQUAL WIDTH VERTICAL PANELS side by side, total aspect ratio 2:1, each panel a tall 2:3 composition. No borders or gaps. NO text, glyphs, frames or UI. Panel1 LEFT: SLAYER martial path, bold cinnabar sword stroke cleaving jagged ink mountains with a small distant wandering swordsman, energetic vermilion and warm charcoal. Panel2 CENTER: SPIRIT summoning path, magnificent guardian lion-beast silhouette and two spirit wolves emerging out of forest ink and swirling jade-green mist, majestic muted jade and warm charcoal. Panel3 RIGHT: ARRAY formation path, layered mountain summits surrounding a glowing antique-gold circular formation with five tall seal stones, exactly the aesthetic of the left faction art in approved concept. Each painting large and sophisticated, no cartoon icon. Hero shapes centered in the lower 65% of each panel so the upper 25% stays pale ivory as room for a code-rendered class glyph. Every picture feathers delicately into identical flat warm ivory #e9d6ad at the outer edges. All panels separate and centered, no crossing between panels, coordinate-friendly uniform grid. Not photoreal, premium Chinese ink-and-mineral-pigment illustration.

Use case: game illustration sprite atlas. Match the approved reference's beautifully painted complete illustrations for 阵中藏灵 and 移山换阵. Output exactly 3 columns x 3 rows, 9 equal SQUARE cells, overall SQUARE canvas. No gaps, borders, labels, lettering, UI, numbers or text. Each cell a complete centered authored ink-and-mineral-pigment scene feathering softly into the SAME pale ivory #e9d6ad at edges, ample painted detail and 8% blank edge clearance. These are large card illustrations, not tiny abstract logos. Reading row order:
top-left: THREE sweeping crossed sword slashes in warm silver and cinnabar against ink clouds.
top-center: a travelling swordsman leaving a curved dark crimson blade trail among bamboo.
top-right: a fierce martial scribe channelling a vermilion-red brush sword from a long scroll.
middle-left: two linked glowing ochre-gold circular formations among rocky peaks.
middle-center: magnificent ochre-gold guardian lion arising out of a circular rune formation and stone pillars, like reference's first talent.
middle-right: levitating craggy mountains with flowing golden ley lines and a brilliant circular formation beneath, like reference's second talent.
bottom-left: two green-gold spirit wolves/lions symmetrically guarding a robed summoner in a jade forest.
bottom-center: an ethereal small jade spirit mimicking a swirling five-element spell.
bottom-right: an enormous regal ink lion ancestor with golden mane and green spectral wisps.
Use full rich highly polished Chinese brush paintings, subtle gold highlights, varied clear silhouettes, never flat clipart. Cell centers MUST fall at 1/6, 1/2, 5/6 in x and y. No image crosses a cell.

Use case: game instructional illustration atlas, match the approved reference warm-ivory manuscript and rich painterly Chinese ink and cinnabar art. Output 3 equal square scenes side-by-side in one image of exactly 3:1 aspect ratio. No dividers, text, numerals, borders, UI or labels. Each scene feathers into identical clean pale ivory #e9d6ad, 8% blank margins.
LEFT scene: a painted fingertip tracing a dark circular ink stroke that joins itself, encircling five small ancient stones emanating subtle golden formation energy.
CENTER scene: handsome blue-robed wandering swordsman with sword sweeping a vivid cinnabar-red long curved slash towards a single dark grey wolf, sweeping motion and beautiful cloth folds, original Chinese ink mineral-pigment illustration.
RIGHT scene: three grey ink wolves frozen in time as three glowing golden-vermilion sword strokes hang suspended around them, crisp frozen fragments around paws, warm gold aura.
Equal centered square art cells, no overlap, no dark inset rectangle, not screenshot cutouts, no white patchwork. Painterly artisanal high quality as a real wuxia game's martial handbook.
